intent: A J-profile wall hook printed as one part: a flat mounting plate that screws to the wall, an arm projecting horizontally from its lower edge, and an upturned retaining lip at the arm's end so hung items cannot slide off. Plate prints flat on the bed.

parts.description: J-hook: 6 mm back plate, 30 mm arm, 20 mm lip, 20 mm wide
parts.part_notes: Load hangs on the arm; bending at the plate-arm corner.

engineering_rationale.load_path: hung item weight hangs on the arm, bending into the plate-arm corner, per part_notes
engineering_rationale.check: corner_wall_mm = 6 mm >= 4 mm min for a 90-degree bend joint under bending load (PLA)
